angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 483,511 km at 63.89 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 15.6529 +/- 0.0126 mas (same row, RUWE 0.82): 63.89 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.695 +/- 0.027 solar radii from Burt et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-824 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract): 483,511 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.71 +/- 0.032 solar masses from Burt et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-824 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4600 +/- 110 K from Burt et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-824 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Burt et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-824 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-824.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.605, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-824 (pscomppars): spectral type K4 V, from Burt et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, SCR J1448-5735: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-824 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.092 dex, from Burt et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-824 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.70997, from Burt et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-824 (pscomppars): age 7.5 Gyr, from Burt et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..153B/abstract)

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.695 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.086. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.
